fields.description: The domain the report is about, as the reporter names it in its policies. It is the Mail Domain's name whenever a site holds the domain.
fields.label: Domain

fields.description: The site that held the domain when the report was fetched, set only if the report was also addressed to one of its domains; the site API shows the report to this site only.
fields.label: Mail Site

fields.description: The cluster that intercepted the report. Stalwart parses reports mailed to postmaster@ and keeps them for a month.
fields.label: Stalwart Cluster

fields.description: The id of the TlsExternalReport object on the cluster; with the cluster it says whether a report is stored already.
fields.label: Stalwart ID

fields.description: The organisation whose servers delivered mail to the domain and sent the report, such as Google Inc.
fields.label: Reporter

fields.description: The address the report was mailed from.
fields.label: Reporter Email

fields.description: How the reporter asks to be reached about the report, often a mailto: address.
fields.label: Reporter Contact

fields.description: The reporter's own id for the report; the same report resent carries the same id.
fields.label: Report ID

fields.description: The subject line of the message that carried the report.
fields.label: Subject

fields.description: The addresses the reporter mailed the report to, one per line; postmaster@ of the domain, normally.
fields.label: Sent To

fields.description: The start of the period the report covers, usually one day.
fields.label: Range Begins

fields.description: The end of the period the report covers.
fields.label: Range Ends

fields.description: When the cluster received the report.
fields.label: Received At

fields.description: When Stalwart drops its copy; the report stays here until the retention in Mail Settings runs out.
fields.label: Expires On Cluster

fields.description: Connections the reporter's servers made to the domain's MX hosts in the period, summed over the policies.
fields.label: Sessions

fields.description: Connections that negotiated TLS the way the policy asks for.
fields.label: Successful

fields.description: Connections that could not; the failures below say why.
fields.label: Failed

fields.description: The kinds of policy the reporter applied, comma-separated: sts (MTA-STS), tlsa (DANE) or no-policy-found.
fields.label: Policy Types

fields.description: One row per policy the reporter evaluated, with the sessions it counted under it.
fields.label: Policies

fields.description: One row per kind of failure and receiving host, as the reporter grouped the failed sessions.
fields.label: Failures

fields.description: The TlsExternalReport object exactly as the cluster answered it, for anything the fields above leave out.
fields.label: Stalwart Object
